correctness.rationale: Automorphism averaging preserves feasibility and cannot increase the spectral norm. The four invariant eigenspace types are reconstructed by reflection and page permutation. The lower bounds mu>=1-b and mu>=sqrt(m)b prove the sharp m=2 optimum; mu>=1-1/m proves all m>=3, with explicit feasible saturating spectra. Equality rigidity establishes the invariant c interval and the fixed central edge for every global optimizer. The bundled exact-symbolic/numerical script checks directly constructed full matrices; computations are supplementary, not infinity proofs.

value.rationale: The m quadrilateral-book family is the canonical two-layer star product. A sharp two-to-three-page cutoff makes an actual communication edge compulsory at m=2 and forbidden in every global optimizer at m>=3, despite positive optimized leaf-layer links; this is a non-factorization of fastest mixing on a natural graph product. The complete invariant-optimizer interval additionally quantifies degeneracy of best designs. This is an unbounded, motivated exact optimization classification, not an arbitrary numeric slice or restatement of a known complete-bipartite optimum.
